Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 83. Category: form. Namekians.

Transformation/Power-Up
Drawing out the powers of your Namekian fusion has
created a Super Namekian!
Increase your Power by 1
Increase your Movement Speed by 5 ft.
Increase the bonuses by an extra 5 ft and
power +1 for each Namekian you fuse with, to
a maximum equal to your proficiency bonus.
At the end of your turn, you lose 3 Stamina
This can be used as a Power-Up for double stamina
cost.
Obtained after merging with at least 1 other
Namekian
